  • Billy Milligan

    Premiered on Jun 23, 2016

    Longlist of the Golden Mask — Russia's National Theatre Award, 2017

  • The Charlie Gordon Effect

A production based on real events from the life of William Stanley Milligan — one of the most famous people in the history of psychiatry diagnosed with "multiple personality disorder." Billy Milligan was charged with committing a series of serious crimes, after which he was placed in a psychiatric hospital for medical examinations and to await his court verdict. Criminal or victim? Actor or madman? Can 24 personalities coexist within one person at the same time?

Set designer: Anvar Gumarov | Sound designer: Dmitry Madera | Lighting designer: Anastasia Kuznetsova | Assistant director: Ksenia Zhuravleva | Video art: Polina Lumier

Cast: Vitaly Gudkov/Bogdan Gudymenko, Lidia Markovskikh/Polina Vasilyeva/Elizaveta Kafieva, Alexander Khudyakov/Egor Shmyga, Artem Khvosteev/Stanislav Belozerov, Yulia Grishaeva, Alexander Lushin, Kristina Tokareva/Varya Svetlova, Roman Weber, Polina Voychenko, Alexey Vdovin/Egor Zakrenichny, Darya Bukshtai, Pavel Filippov

Directed by Igor Sergeev and Varya Svetlova

18+
